description: Serialize a single portlet record into its canonical XML wire form. The record is rendered as a '<portlet>' element containing a '<portlet-name>' element for the identifier, a '<portlet-class>' element for the implementation class, and one '<init-param>' element per initialization parameter, each wrapping a '<name>' and a '<value>' element. Initialization parameters appear in the order supplied and init-param elements are not wrapped in any container element. The raw XML string is printed followed by a newline.
